label: In test code (a test_ function, @Test method or it()/test() block, after at least one earlier line), the check line: unit-test assertion calls (self.assertX methods, JUnit assertEquals, mock assert_called_with, pytest.raises, expect(...).toBe/toEqual) and bare assert statements, peaking on the assert or matcher token. The framework names pytest/unittest also fire, even in prose. Not assert statements in ordinary non-test functions, not other calls, prints or setup lines inside tests, not 'assert' in everyday prose.
